extracted.intended_audience: professional and student photojournalists, documentary photographers, multimedia journalists submitting work to POY
extracted.subtask_description: Submitting photographic or multimedia work to the 76th Annual Pictures of the Year International (POY) competition; includes categories in photojournalism, documentary, sports, people, and portrait. The page lists deadlines, prizes, usage-rights, and thematic focus for entrants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must be received by this date to be considered for the competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission / Website
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants should submit entries through the POY website (follow the 'ENTER CONTEST' link on the official site).

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No entry fee is charged according to this listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prizes and awards
rubrics_metrics.description: POY awards cash prizes and Tiffany crystal trophies for top Premier winners and plaques/certificates for individual category placements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top Premier winners receive $1,000 cash & Tiffany crystal trophies for Photographer of the Year, Documentary Project of the Year, World Understanding Award; $500 cash & Tiffany crystal trophies for select other Premier categories (e.g., Newspaper Photographer of the Year, Sports Photographer of the Year, Multimedia Photographer of the Year, Environmental Vision Award, Community Awareness Award, Best Photography Book Award). Individual category winners: 1st — engraved plaque; 2nd, 3rd, & AE — certificate awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No eligibility details are provided on this page; entrants should consult the official POY site for specific eligibility rules (e.g., professional vs. student categories, publication-date windows, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyrights & usage rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Pictures of the Year International (POY) recognizes and respects that copyrights are held by the photographer and/or news organization. I grant permission to Pictures of the Year International and the Missouri School of Journalism to use my submitted photographs in exhibitions, in publications, and in promotions of the competition itself, and for educational, research, and historical record purposes concerning Pictures of the Year International. This usage includes, but is not limited to, slides/tapes, television film/tapes, videodisc, DVDs, CDs, websites, and any other type of mechanical, electronic, or digital dissemination system. Winning photographs, published tearsheets, editing displays, multimedia productions, and other images selected for historic significance become part of the permanent POY Archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants retain copyright but grant POY and the Missouri School of Journalism broad rights to use submitted images for exhibitions, publications, promotions, education, research, historical records, and digital/mechanical dissemination; winning works become part of the permanent POY Archive. Check full rules for any limitations, attribution, or licensing details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Themes / subject categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Theme: Photojournalism; Documentary; Sports; People; Portrait
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should align with these thematic areas — judges will be evaluating work within these subject/category contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition focus
rubrics_metrics.description: POY recognizes excellence in photojournalism, multimedia, and visual editing and is committed to engaging citizens worldwide with great documentary photography by sponsoring educational public exhibitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work will be assessed for excellence in photojournalism, multimedia storytelling, and visual editing, and for its ability to engage audiences and serve documentary/educational purposes.
